'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Casey Anis DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: sheet Name reads "Corey Anis"; same player as LS p06 (Casey Anis) — small-world rule

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
